categories.main_business_segments: Science Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. primarily operates in heavy metal pollution prevention and control, offering comprehensive solutions, product sales, and operation services. Its business covers treatment of heavy metal-containing acid wastewater, waste residue, environmental remediation, production and sales of environmental protection agents and copper extractants, environmental equipment manufacturing, design, technical services, environmental consulting, and environmental monitoring.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced technologies such as heavy metal pollution comprehensive treatment, resource recovery, and environmental remediation. Key technologies include sulfuric acid resource recovery, deep treatment and reuse of heavy metal wastewater, arsenic-containing hazardous waste detoxification, and integrated heavy metal wastewater treatment equipment. It employs biological agents, polymer adsorbents, stabilizers, oxidants, and mineralizers in its products. Production methods include customized manufacturing of core equipment, auxiliary non-standard and standard equipment, and stock production of environmental agents and copper extractants.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are large-scale non-ferrous metal mining, beneficiation, and smelting enterprises, industrial parks, and government entities. The company serves the heavy metal pollution prevention market, including copper, lead, zinc, and other non-ferrous metal industries, as well as environmental remediation projects. It also targets overseas markets through subsidiaries and international projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant presence in Hunan, Fujian, and other provinces. It has subsidiaries in Serbia, Australia, and Hong Kong, serving international markets including South America, Europe, and Southeast Asia. Domestic revenue accounts for approximately 75.7% of total revenue, with overseas markets contributing about 24.3%.
categories.supply_chain_position: Science Environmental Protection operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the heavy metal pollution control supply chain. It provides integrated solutions, manufactures specialized environmental protection agents and equipment, and offers operation and maintenance services, positioning itself as a comprehensive service provider rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in heavy metal pollution prevention technologies, resource recovery, and new materials. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on advanced biological agents, selective adsorption materials, resource recycling technologies for rare metals like rhenium, and smart integrated equipment. The strategic direction includes expanding resource recovery and new materials markets, accelerating technology industrialization, and enhancing digitalization and intelligent operation of environmental services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through three main streams: comprehensive heavy metal pollution prevention solutions (including engineering projects and customized equipment sales), product sales (environmental agents, copper extractants, and integrated wastewater treatment equipment), and operation services (third-party environmental facility management). Contracts are obtained via public bidding, competitive negotiation, and direct procurement.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading high-tech enterprise in China's heavy metal pollution prevention sector, recognized for its core technologies and comprehensive solutions. It competes with domestic and international firms in environmental protection and chemical agents, including multinational chemical giants in copper extractants. The industry is fragmented with high entry barriers, and Science Environmental Protection is positioned as a technology and service leader with growing market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 927 million, a 14.69% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 180.76 million, doubling from the previous year. Total assets reached RMB 1.83 billion, up 22.31%, and net assets attributable to shareholders were RMB 1.07 billion, up 15.30%. The company has shown strong growth driven by business structure optimization, increased R&D investment, and strategic acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Science Environmental Protection offers integrated, cost-effective, and technologically advanced heavy metal pollution control solutions with high resource recovery rates and low environmental impact. Its proprietary biological agents and specialized chemical products enable simultaneous removal of multiple heavy metals and pollutants with high efficiency and low operational costs. The company’s standardized, modular, and intelligent equipment solutions provide flexibility and scalability, enhancing customer value through improved environmental compliance and operational efficiency.
